_note: babyhairtreatment SHARES babybath's tables: dict = babybath.babybath_dict, QA = babybath.product_id_dict_qa. Only filter_babyhairtreatment is its own. This file is therefore a copy of babybath.json - keep the two in sync.

sku_type.note: The dict identity column is sku_type (there is NO sku_type_complete column on babybath_dict; the QA table's sku_type_complete is populated from this value). sub_brand already carries the brand prefix (e.g. 'Cussons Baby Hair Lotion'), so brand is NOT concatenated again. Empty sources are NOT skipped: the dominant convention is a raw CONCAT with a single-space separator, so an empty `function` leaves a literal double space (e.g. 'Moell Paket Special  Bundling 4 in 1'). Measured 2026-09-11 on rows with non-empty sub_brand+packsize and empty function: 628 double-space vs 104 single-space. New rows follow the double-space majority so downstream exact-string joins on sku_type keep matching.

keywords.note: When keywords_typo is empty/null, keywords is a verbatim copy of sku_type; otherwise the typo string is prefixed.

packsize.note: '<number> <unit>' with a space, unit lowercase ('100 ml', '75 gr'). Multipacks append ' x <n> pcs' ('400 ml x 2 pcs'); a shorter ' x <n>' form exists in legacy rows. Multi-item bundles join components with ' + ' ('600 ml + 100 ml'). Pick-your-own listings use the literal 'Multi Variant'.

ingredients.note: When no ingredient is known, every ingredient_N column and `ingredients` are set to the literal 'Not Available'.
